source_variants.note: Source correction: the English 1996–1997 collection misprints the last exponent as 1/2. Both inspected Chinese compilations print the twelfth power for every variable; this consistent version is retained.

The English collection lists i=1,...,16 and defines an eighteenth entry but does not explicitly print the wraparound difference. Both Chinese compilations explicitly include the difference between the images of 1 and 17. The bank retains this complete cyclic condition, with positive iteration indices.

Source-domain variant: the English collection restricts the sequence to nonnegative integers. Both inspected Chinese compilations say a nonnegative sequence without an integrality restriction. The bank renders this as nonnegative real terms; the bound is valid for that domain.

formula_spot_check: 1994 P5 binomial identity verified for n=1,...,25; not a substitute for a general proof.
